book.name: Mareko
book.title: Mareko Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Marekoꞌa Mirihiro

content: Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, izidi ꞌada edau radiuꞌeteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano vaze nuꞌa ꞌizema rudanogano Badiꞌaꞌa gigiꞌaḡa hina aradu zuhiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe horoniꞌuma.”
Iesu Iraḡaniꞌa Nufiro
Mada fuꞌo tiba fare enogano Iesuꞌa Petero, Iakobo ebu Ioane zamazadu zeḡe daꞌo maḡa boro itiro. Eꞌea ani iraḡaniꞌa zeḡe zamao nufiro.
Dabuaḡaꞌe ꞌurau vazavazahiro. Haba niduꞌa zamaḡano vazeni ꞌahoga zuni vuzuꞌe dehenadu ꞌouge ꞌuranogaꞌe mene idararo.
Ebu zeḡe zamao Elia zu Moseꞌa fureranadu Iesu teite ḡoeriro.
ꞌOugadu Peteroꞌa Iesu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, eme ꞌahao radiune manoḡa. Emeḡe uḡiduꞌa nugo taruha uḡidu ogoratihi. Tibaꞌe ḡae veize, tibaꞌe Mose veize ebu tibaꞌe Elia veize ogoraꞌuma.”
Peteroꞌe nagini raꞌetaꞌaꞌe mene ederiro, mazaḡa ze rihau rudaro.
Ebu ḡozeꞌa fureranadu ze ogoziro ebu ḡozeonoꞌo ago ꞌahoganiꞌa ziro, “ꞌAhiꞌe eḡe zamarone Ubude. Za ani ḡoere egohanoꞌi.”
Ḡarihe fase zeꞌa ehamu vaḡirotene, vazeni ꞌahoga mene horoniro, rehano Iesu daꞌo horoniro.
Ze maḡanonoꞌo ovairoteꞌea, Iesuꞌa riḡa ziro, “Zaꞌa horonataꞌaꞌe vazeni ꞌahoga ago noꞌi, onamo Vaze Ubuganiꞌa rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡabodiꞌuma.”
ꞌOugadu ze nagini horoniroteꞌe zeḡe daꞌo zamariro, rehano runeonoꞌo ḡabodiꞌuma rae reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa huga moneo ḡadimutitiro.
Ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa Iesu ḡadiniro, “Nougadu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa, ꞌEliaꞌe ibite ariꞌuma,' rae raꞌohe?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Hube hune Eliaꞌa ibite aradu ḡau niduꞌa ruhibiꞌuma. Buka Zaḡoḡano ꞌahige rae mirihiro, 'Vaze Ubugaꞌe aduga boro hidiꞌuma ebu vazeꞌa ani hezahohaꞌuma.' Aꞌe nougadu mirihiro?
Eḡeꞌa ziꞌohe, Elia ꞌai amahi ariro. Rehano vazeꞌa ani mene ederadu Buka Zaḡoḡano ane moneo mirihiroteꞌe teige, ani mazao zeḡe ura haḡaiḡa haḡairo.”
Tahiꞌa Komeꞌa Vine Sauꞌaḡeta Fainiro

Iesu zu ane tahiꞌa uḡiduꞌa ane tahiꞌa ꞌahogaꞌahoga vaḡe ovairotene, vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌa edau ḡeḡezeꞌeteꞌe, zu Mose goro ḡoeꞌa ihozeꞌeteꞌe azaḡaniꞌa zeḡe teite taꞌirotiteꞌeteꞌe horoziro.
Vaze niduꞌa Iesu horonadu ḡihau zaguzagaro, ebu ani uꞌa dure onamadu ani mazao, “Manoḡahe?” rae unihiro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ḡadiziro, “Zaꞌe zeḡe teite nagini moneo taꞌirotiteꞌohe?”
Vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa boꞌaḡano vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa naenaeniro, “Ihore vazeḡa, e eḡe ubude ḡae vaḡe tutune areha. Aniꞌe vine sauꞌaniꞌa agatohanadu ḡoerogaꞌe mene idaḡa.

Vine sauꞌaniꞌa noumao ani agatohauꞌetene, ani rahao mae feuneꞌohe. ꞌOugadu ani hebeꞌano busureꞌohe, ḡonoga atiteꞌohe ebu ahiꞌaniꞌa taiduꞌohe. E ḡae tahiꞌatahiꞌa mazao vine sauꞌa hegone bunoga veize umizeha, rehano ze mene idaraneha.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Zaꞌe mene fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa! E zae teite noꞌe faḡa radiꞌuma? E zae mazao noꞌe faḡa zamahe obone tiꞌuma? Tahiꞌa komeꞌa eꞌe eḡe vaḡe tutune aroꞌi.”
Eꞌanoꞌo ze ani tutune ariro. Vine sauꞌaniꞌa Iesu horonirotene, zogone tahiꞌa komeꞌa aꞌe mae ketoketonadu aniꞌe rahao higau bauriro ebu hebeꞌano busureꞌenaꞌa, kiure ragaviro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌa moga ḡadiniro, “Ani noꞌe madaḡanonoꞌo ugi ꞌahi meiro?” Moganiꞌa naenaeniro, “Ani komeꞌa madaḡanonoꞌo meiro.
Vine sauꞌaniꞌa ḡae ḡehaḡa ani manoga veize ire rogao ga vuo ani mae feuniro. Rehano ḡaeꞌa ḡauni ꞌahoga haḡaogaꞌe idaḡa roꞌidene, emeḡe vetuḡafoꞌi zu danafoꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “'Idaḡa roꞌidene,' rae ago roꞌi. Iniu fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡaꞌe ḡau niduꞌa haḡaogaꞌe idaḡa.”
Tahiꞌa komeꞌa moganiꞌa zogone agoḡa boro hina ḡihau niro, “E fieꞌohe. Eḡeꞌa fieꞌetaꞌaꞌe zoreḡa ꞌahine, eḡe danahoꞌi!”

Iesuꞌa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa dure areꞌeteꞌe horozirotene, vine sauꞌa roniro, “Vaze mae teḡa kuru zu mumutafa azaḡano sausauzeꞌeteꞌe viga, eḡeꞌa riḡa ḡaꞌohe, ani mazaonoꞌo buanoꞌi ebu ani mazao ago bare diuḡoꞌi.”
ꞌOugirotene, vine sauꞌaniꞌa ḡihau ḡaniḡanaro ebu tahiꞌa komeꞌa mae ketoketonadu buau vaḡiniro. Tahiꞌa aꞌe rune vazeḡa teigiro ꞌahine, zeḡeꞌa, “Ani rudaneha,” rae reiro.
Rehano Iesuꞌa ꞌevoꞌano ani obonadu abine ḡihinirotene, ani edau iḡuniro.
Iesuꞌa ne ꞌahoga diuḡirotene, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa sifu ḡadiniro, “Emeꞌa nougadu vine sauꞌa hegone bunoga mene idaraneha?”
Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “ꞌAhiguḡa vine sauꞌaꞌe kuru
hina daꞌo mae buzeꞌohe.”
Iesuꞌa Ane Rune moneo Bare rae Fureniro
Ze eꞌe habaꞌa modadu Galilea habaꞌa vitau onamiro. Iesuꞌe vazeni ꞌahoganiꞌa ze noumao radiuꞌetaꞌaꞌe ederoga mene uratiro,
mazaḡa aniꞌe ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ihozinu. Aniꞌa ꞌahige rae ziro, “Vaze Ubugaꞌe agireḡa ꞌevoreo riꞌiniꞌuma. Ze ani maꞌuma ebu mada uḡidu enogano aniꞌa bare ḡabodiꞌuma.”
Rehano Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe ane ḡoere huga mene ederiro ebu eꞌe moneo bare ḡadimanoga zuni riharo.
Iniuꞌe Ḡihiꞌa hune?
Ze Kaperanauma neḡa onamiro. Iesuꞌa neo radirotene, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ḡadiziro, “Za ibio nagi moneo roteteha?”
Rehano ze sifu radiro, mazaḡa ze ibio iniuꞌe ḡihiꞌa hune moneo rotetiro.
Iesuꞌa ehoriroteꞌe enogano ane tahiꞌa gaubanana aheu fare huzadu ziro, “Iniuꞌe vaze ibiꞌa reihi reine, aniꞌe vaze ḡonaga rae radu vaze niduꞌa tuḡure vazeḡano reꞌuma.”
Aniꞌa tahiꞌa komeꞌa ꞌahoga zamahanadu zeḡe boꞌaḡano ohoniro ebu ane ꞌevore hina ohanadu ziro,
“Iniuꞌa eḡe niḡano tahiꞌa komeꞌa ꞌahiguḡa mae ḡihinine, aniꞌe eḡe mae ḡihiheꞌohe. Ebu iniuꞌa eḡe mae ḡihihine, aniꞌe eḡe daꞌo mene mae ḡihiheꞌohe, rehano eḡe tuḡuhiroteꞌe Badiꞌaḡa mae ḡihineꞌohe.”
Eme mene Agirofiꞌeteꞌe Vazeḡaꞌe Emeḡe none Vazeḡa
Ioaneꞌa Iesu niro, “Ihore vazeḡa, eme vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa ḡae niḡano vine sauꞌasauꞌa hegoze buziroteꞌe horoniro. ꞌOugadu emeḡeꞌa ani garariro, mazaḡa aniꞌe mene emeḡe none vazeḡa.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Ani ago gararoꞌi. Iniuꞌa eḡe niḡano haḡai gigiꞌa haḡairoteꞌe ḡarugano eḡe rae sausauheꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe oꞌoꞌa.
Eme mene agirofiꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe emeḡe none vazeḡa.
Eḡeꞌa hube hune ziꞌohe, iniuꞌa zaꞌe Keriso mone azaḡa radu vu bioḡa tiba ziniꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe aniꞌa meiteꞌe naeḡa mene hune dauniꞌuma.”
Vaze Haḡai Sauꞌano Tutune Veꞌoneꞌeteꞌe Vazeḡa
“Ebu eḡe mazao fieꞌeteꞌe azaḡa komeꞌakomeꞌa ꞌahiguḡa boꞌaḡano tiba zuni haḡai sauꞌano tutune veꞌoneꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaꞌe hadi horeḡa ane ꞌunuo autadu davarao mae feunineꞌe ufeta manoḡa.

ꞌEvoreḡo naeḡaniꞌa haḡai sauꞌano tutuꞌe veꞌoꞌoꞌidene, variꞌe modoꞌi. ꞌEvo'o tiba hina ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidogaꞌe ufeta manoḡa. Aꞌe ꞌevoreḡo aheu hina ire roga mene hauḡeꞌeteꞌe zamaḡano mae feuꞌoga vitineꞌohe.
Odaḡo naeḡaniꞌa haḡai sauꞌano tutuꞌe veꞌoꞌoꞌidene, variꞌe modoꞌi. Odaḡo tiba hina ḡabone tuḡutuḡu hidogaꞌe ufeta manoḡa. Aꞌe odaḡo aheu hina ire roga radiu tuḡutuḡu zamaḡano mae feuꞌoga vitineꞌohe.

Ubumaḡo naeḡaniꞌa haḡai sauꞌano tutuꞌe veꞌoꞌoꞌidene, ḡude modoꞌi. Ubumaḡo tiba hina Badiꞌaꞌa zihiꞌaziꞌeteꞌe habaꞌa diuḡogaꞌe ufeta manoḡa. Aꞌe ubumaḡo aheu hina ire roga radiu tuḡutuḡu zamaḡano mae feuꞌoga vitineꞌohe.
Ire rogao radiu tuḡutuḡeꞌeteꞌe idiḡa ḡehaḡaniꞌa ahirize aꞌuma ebu ire rogaꞌe mene hune vidaꞌuma.
Dibuꞌo rana dama teadu deheneꞌeteꞌe teige, vaze niduꞌaꞌe ire roga hina deheziꞌuma.
Damaꞌe manoḡa, rehano iniganiꞌa hauḡine, nougenouge bare inidaꞌuma? Zae boꞌaḡano dama teadu unihotitoꞌi.”
